candidates.source_name: Profession.hu (largest HU job board) - banking/finance & IT categories
candidates.why_relevant: Hungary's dominant general job board; nearly every HU bank, processor and BPO posts here. Volume and role-title mix per employer is the earliest demand signal for programmes (core banking migration, instant payment/AFR, AML).
candidates.legal_status: ToS likely restricts scraping; robots.txt to be checked
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic keyword+employer query crawl of listing pages (hu and /en mirror), store title/employer/location/date; low request rate, respect robots.txt
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language seed query + snowball to employer profile pages
queries_used: profession.hu banki állás fizetési rendszer fejlesztő

candidates.source_name: Profession.hu employer profile pages (company-level vacancy roll-up)
candidates.why_relevant: Stable per-employer IDs give a clean time series of open-role counts per bank without name-matching noise - ideal for tracking hiring bursts at MBH, UniCredit, OTP etc.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Maintain a mapping of bank -> profession employer ID; poll weekly and diff role lists
queries_used: MBH Bank Nyrt. állás munka karrier

candidates.why_relevant: Second major HU board, strong in white-collar finance/compliance roles and in agency-posted (unnamed employer) mandates - agency ads often reveal confidential bank programmes before they are announced.
candidates.legal_status: ToS restricts bulk reuse; verify robots.txt
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Filtered listing crawl by location+keyword (hu and /en paths); capture recruitment_agency flag

candidates.source_name: Jobline.hu (HVG group job board) - status: announced shutdown
candidates.why_relevant: Historically a major HVG-owned white-collar board; reporting found in search states operations cease 31 Jan 2026, so it is at best an archival/back-fill source. Must be validated, not assumed live.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off liveness check; if dead, use web.archive.org snapshots for historical HU banking vacancy baselines
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu seed query on HVG job products

candidates.source_name: HVG Allasborze (Jobline job fair) exhibitor lists
candidates.why_relevant: Twice-yearly national career fair; the exhibitor roster and the roles each bank/fintech advertises there is a compact, dated snapshot of who is in growth mode.

candidates.why_relevant: Third-tier but regionally connected board (SK/CZ background per HR Portal history); useful for shared-service-centre and back-office banking roles outside Budapest.

candidates.source_name: OTP Bank career portal (SuccessFactors-style ATS, karrier.otpbank.hu)
candidates.why_relevant: Largest HU bank's own ATS with a full 'view all jobs' index and stable category folders (IT és digitalizáció, üzletfejlesztés és innováció, banki biztonság/jog/compliance). Category-level counts map almost 1:1 onto the bank's org design and programme load.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /viewalljobs/ and each /go/<category>/<id>/ folder weekly; parse title, org unit, location, posting date; diff for new programme keywords (azonnali fizetés, core banking, AML)
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu seed query + snowball into ATS category folder IDs
queries_used: OTP karrier állásajánlat instant fizetés projektvezető

candidates.why_relevant: KBC-owned top-5 HU bank; own vacancy list is the authoritative feed for its digital/payments and compliance hiring.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of /allasok listing with pagination; snapshot titles+dates

candidates.why_relevant: MBH is the merged MKB/Budapest Bank/Takarek group - integration programmes (core migration, branch network rationalisation) show up as role clusters before public announcements.

candidates.why_relevant: Top-5 HU bank vacancy feed; also a concrete example of the Nexum 'Karrier Portál' ATS whose URL pattern (<brand>.karrierportal.hu/allasok) generalises to many HU financial employers.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read vendor reference/customer pages; subdomain enumeration on karrierportal.hu via passive DNS / certificate transparency to discover further financial tenants
candidates.discovered_via_method: pattern noticed across bank career URLs, then vendor site lookup

candidates.why_relevant: Cross-tenant search over all SmartRecruiters customers, so a single query surfaces HU postings from employers whose ATS tenant is otherwise unknown - a discovery channel as well as a feed.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Erste is a top-5 HU bank; missing its primary feed leaves a hole in the demand signal for one of the largest payment/digital programmes in the market.

negative_findings.description: No CIB Bank (Intesa Sanpaolo HU) career page was returned despite an explicit hu query naming CIB.
negative_findings.result_summary: CIB career/ATS URL unresolved in this slice.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: CIB is a significant HU bank; its hiring is invisible to the collector until the portal is located.

negative_findings.description: Hungarian payment-fintech employers Barion, OTP Mobil (Simple), PayPal-adjacent and acquirer/PSP vendors returned no career-page hits in the hu query used.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: PSPs and acquirers are exactly where instant-payment / qvik / SoftPOS engineering demand shows up first; the cell is currently bank-heavy.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: If true, a 25-year HU vacancy archive disappears; historical baselines should be captured from web archives before relying on it.

negative_findings.description: Indeed.hu and LinkedIn Jobs dominate HU result pages but are anti-bot / auth-walled respectively; no direct fetch was attempted, so their state is a hypothesis not a verdict.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two highest-volume aggregators are collectable only manually or under licence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated volume tracking must rest on Profession/CVonline/own-ATS feeds instead; aggregator counts can only be used as occasional spot-checks.

negative_findings.description: No Hungarian-language vocabulary was established for Workday tenant naming, so Workday-hosted HU bank career sites (myworkdayjobs.com tenants) could not be located by hu-language search in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Workday tenant inventory for HU financial employers is empty.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Several foreign-owned banks route HU vacancies through group Workday tenants; without the tenant list those roles are missed entirely.

coverage_gaps.description: Missing own-ATS feeds for Erste Hungary, CIB Bank, Magyar Bankholding-adjacent entities, Takarekbank legacy units, and the HU savings/credit-institution long tail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest bankweb.hu directory links and the MNB list of authorised credit institutions, then resolve each institution's career URL and ATS vendor.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-specific employers (PSPs, acquirers, POS/ATM vendors, card processors, wallet providers) are under-covered versus banks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an explicit HU payments-actor list (Barion, OTP Mobil/Simple, GIRO, card processors, POS/ATM service firms) and locate each career page; add hu terms such as elfogado, kartyaelfogadas, POS terminal, tranzakcio.

coverage_gaps.description: Workday, SAP SuccessFactors and Oracle/Taleo tenants used by foreign-owned HU banks were not enumerated; only Nexum karrierportal.hu, Greenhouse, Lever and SmartRecruiters patterns were established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run tenant discovery (certificate transparency, site: queries on myworkdayjobs.com / successfactors.eu with Budapest and Hungary) and add each resolved tenant as a structured feed.

coverage_gaps.description: Sources found give current-vacancy snapshots only; no historical baseline exists, so 'burst' detection has nothing to compare against.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Start weekly snapshotting immediately and back-fill from web.archive.org for the top 10 employer ATS pages to establish a 12-24 month baseline.

coverage_gaps.description: Leadership moves are only weakly observable from vacancy data; executive-search mandates and confidential agency ads were not systematically mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add HU executive-search and IT-staffing firms (agency-posted ads on CVonline/Profession flagged recruitment_agency=1) as a distinct source subtype.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetched and confirmed live; all liveness statements are search-result-derived.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness/robots pass over every candidate URL before collection is scheduled.

brief: Hungary's vacancy-signal landscape splits into three collectable layers: two dominant general boards (Profession.hu, CVonline.hu) whose per-employer profile pages give clean company-level time series; bank-owned ATS portals, most of which sit either on OTP's own SuccessFactors-style site (karrier.otpbank.hu, with a full view-all-jobs index and stable category folders) or on the Nexum *.karrierportal.hu tenant family that also hosts GIRO and legacy MKB - making one parser reusable across several institutions; and international ATS feeds (Greenhouse, Lever, SmartRecruiters) where Budapest hubs of foreign fintechs such as Wise and Revolut publish. The richest payment-infrastructure signal is the smallest source: GIRO Zrt.'s career portal plus MNB's careers and subsidiary-offers pages, where instant-payment and supervisory roles appear directly. Main weaknesses are the absent Erste HU and CIB feeds, an unmapped Workday/SuccessFactors tenant layer, thin coverage of PSP/acquirer-side employers, and the fact that the two highest-volume aggregators (Indeed.hu, LinkedIn) are anti-bot or auth-walled and usable only as manual spot-checks.
